findings.description: The code reads a password from a file named 'secret' without any validation or sanitization.
The email content is constructed directly from user input (recipients, subject, body) without any sanitization.
The password is read from a file and used directly in the code without any encryption.
The code uses curl_easy_setopt with CURLOPT_URL, CURLOPT_USERNAME, CURLOPT_PASSWORD, and CURLOPT_MAIL_FROM without any validation.
